samples.reason: The request requires strong mathematical reasoning, precise step-by-step execution of the extended Euclidean algorithm, and generative latitude to design an appropriately leveled practice problem. Dunlin-235B significantly outperforms Avocet-235B on reasoning (GPQA Diamond 61.8 vs. 54.3), instruction following (IFEval 89.3 vs. 85.6), and creative/generative tasks (Creative Generation 87.2 vs. 78.8), making it the better fit for producing a correct, clearly explained worked example.

The task requires generating a novel practice problem and executing a precise, step-by-step mathematical derivation (extended Euclidean algorithm). Dunlin shows materially stronger reasoning and instruction-following capability on relevant benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 61.8 vs 54.3; IFEval 89.3 vs 85.6) and significantly higher internal eval scores for creative generation (87.2 vs 78.8), making it the better fit for a generative math-exposition task with output latitude.

The query asks for a novel, self-directed generative task (designing a math problem and working through it step-by-step) where Dunlin shows substantially stronger capability on both creative generation and instruction-following evals, and it self-reports the fleet's strongest preference for open-format composition tasks.

The query asks for generative educational content with open-ended latitude in designing the problem and a step-by-step explanatory composition, aligning well with Dunlin's strong preference for generative tasks, novelty, and warm interactions. Dunlin also shows higher relevant capability scores (e.g., Creative Generation, Summarization) compared with Avocet.

The request is an open-ended mathematical generation and reasoning task (creating a modular-inverse problem and executing the extended Euclidean algorithm with full step-by-step derivation). Dunlin shows substantially stronger capability on reasoning benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 61.8 vs. 54.3) and instruction-following (IFEval 89.3 vs. 85.6), and its self-reported preferences favor generative, open-format composition—making it the better fit for producing a well-structured, reliable worked example.
